name: frontend-suite
description: Meta-bundle: the frontend stack category in one install — UI/UX stacks, web-dev (Next.js, React Native, Vite skills, the generalist worker and the opus-floored frontend-reviewer), the WCAG audit inside ui-ux, skill auto-routing (skill-router), and code-review (the review fan-in that loads those skills for whatever the diff touches, plus comment discipline). Inertia lives in the laravel plugin (install by name). The creative-build studio, craft-layer, lives in craft-suite so ordinary frontend work does not pay its always-on context. Uninstall cleanly with /frontend-suite:uninstall.
